adopt: Per-snapshot classifier + Savitzky-Golay smoothing produces physically-sensible time-evolving derived quantities at zero parametric inverse-fitting cost — the right abstraction for user-facing 'where is the moisture front right now' UI.
avoid: Setting acceptance metrics (e.g. 'x_core std<0.05 over full bake') without considering that the metric is testing the wrong window — early-bake x_core can legitimately drift before stabilising.
